input.quote: a. it will perform the Services using reasonable care and skill and in accordance with the applicable Service Option Attachments (which means the degree of knowledge, skill and judgment customarily exercised by members of the applicable profession with respect to work of a similar nature)
input.rationale: Section 5.1 gives a services standard-of-care warranty (substantively equivalent to "professional and workmanlike") plus a compliance-with-laws covenant, but there is no conformance warranty for any delivered Materials or Base Components, no warranty period, and no remedy for breach. Section 5.4(c) affirmatively provides all Materials "AS IS" and 5.2 makes 5.1 exclusive, so the disclaimer swallows any conformance protection — walk-away territory on the deliverables side and short of the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with repair, replace, re-perform or refund). Redline adds a 90-day conformance and no-malicious-code warranty with the standard remedy and carves the express warranties out of the "AS IS" disclaimer; the malicious-code element and 12-month software period are noted but we have pitched the 90-day fallback given this is a hosting/services deal.

ops.text: c. for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each Materials deliverable and Base Component provided under this Agreement will conform in all material respects to its applicable documentation and specifications, and will not contain any virus, worm or other malicious code. Customer's remedy for breach of the warranties in this Section 5.1 is, at IBM's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Materials or Base Component, or a refund of the charges paid for the non-conforming Services, Materials or Base Component.

ops.oldText: c. IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES
ops.newText: c. EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1, IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a 90-day conformance warranty for Materials and Base Components with a repair, replace, re-perform or refund remedy, and carved the express warranties out of the "AS IS" disclaimer, since Section 5.1 currently gives no conformance warranty or remedy for non-conforming work. Our playbook position is 12 months for software and 90 days for services deliverables; 90 days here is our fallback and we can work with it.
proposal.summary: Add 90-day conformance warranty, no-malicious-code warranty and a repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy; carve express warranties out of the AS IS disclaimer.
